hints.title: Horizontal Extension
hints.text: For each cell (i, j), determine the contiguous horizontal length extending to the left where all values are <= k and form a non-increasing sequence.

hints.title: Histogram Conversion
hints.text: Treating these horizontal lengths as widths in a column-wise histogram transforms the problem into counting valid sub-rectangles across columns.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack
hints.text: For each column j, scan down row by row using a monotonic stack to maintain active rectangle widths and their frequencies in linear time.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputes horizontal valid segment lengths and aggregates histogram rectangles via a monotonic stack.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(m^2 * n^2) submatrices directly exceeds runtime limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) array storing horizontal segment lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transforms the matrix into horizontal histogram lengths and applies monotonic stack accumulation.
